hook: Yesterday we said sit Bryce Young. Projected eighteen... he finished with eleven point four.
score: Packers twenty-seven, Panthers nineteen. Green Bay's win probability dipped to forty-eight percent... then Jordan Love took over.
studs: The studs. Love, twenty-two and a half with three touchdowns. Chuba Hubbard, twenty-one. Josh Jacobs, twenty, with two scores.
surprise: The surprise. Rookie Matthew Golden: thirteen targets, seventy-nine yards and a touchdown. Seventeen point four.
busts: The busts. Young, Tetairoa McMillan... and Packers kicker Trey Smack, who missed an extra point and finished with two.
verdict: Verdict... Golden is a buy before your league notices. Thirteen targets doesn't lie.
